name: City of White Plains
gaps: White Plains publishes its Zoning Ordinance as a PDF on the city site (cover: amendments through August 3, 2026), not eCode360
No minimum lot width in the schedule (only frontage and depth); min_lot_width_ft null
No impervious/total coverage limit for residence districts in § 5.3; max_impervious_coverage null
RM districts: schedule FAR is marked N- (non-residential uses only), so no residential FAR recorded; RM-2 yards '--' (urban renewal site, fn. b-c)
Steep-slope, tree and stormwater thresholds live in the separate Municipal Code (Ch. 3-5 etc.), which I could not reach online; summaries below come from the zoning ordinance only
Not covered (county non-RES): RM-0.7, RM-0.4, RM-0.35, PSRDD and business districts

wetlands.summary: Zoning § 4.4.25: actions on environmentally sensitive sites (wetlands, aquifer recharge areas, water resources, steep slopes, per Municipal Code Ch. 3-5) are Type I SEQRA actions needing a public hearing; preserve a 50 ft protective buffer around wetlands (extra 50 ft in R1-12.5/R1-20/R1-30 on sites over 3 acres).

steep_slopes.summary: Zoning § 4.4.25.5.5: development on steep slope/rock outcrop areas must avoid or minimize regrading, view and erosion impacts; the slope thresholds are set in Municipal Code Ch. 3-5 (not reached).

trees.summary: Not in the zoning ordinance; the city has Tree Preservation Guidelines (referenced in § 4.4.23.6.4) and a municipal tree law not reviewed here.

stormwater.summary: Not in the zoning ordinance; see City Municipal Code (not reviewed).

adu.summary: No accessory-apartment use in the § 5.1 use schedule; accessory servants' quarters by special permit in some R1 districts, and one roomer per dwelling unit allowed as accessory.

general.accessory_structures: No accessory building in a required yard except as § 5.3 allows (§ 4.4.7); schedule cols 16-19 set max 15 ft height and minimum distances to side/rear lot lines (5-12 ft by district) and to other structures. Minor accessory buildings (< 750 cu ft) permitted as accessory.
general.pools: Special permit use (§ 6.7.3) unless meeting § 4.4.24; pool (from deck edge or rim) at least 15 ft from all lot lines; may be in required yards (§ 4.4.7); above-ground max 60 in.; 6 ft fence.
general.notes: Corner lots: owner may elect which street yard is the front (§ 4.4.9). Lots narrower than 50 ft get reduced side yards (§ 4.4.10).
